newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 15.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 11.95 points to close at 7286.16.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index fell 12.06 points to 1,072.49.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5175/85 a dollar at around 0040 GMT, after ending Kuala Lumpur trading on Wednesday at 2.5240/50.

* The dollar closed lower against the yen in New York on Wednesday, after tumbling to a fresh four-month low. It closed in New York at 117.30/40 yen against 118.65/70 previously. Around 0040 GMT, dollar was at 116.80/90.
* Hicom Holdings said it has signed a joint venture agreement to manufacture trucks with Japan's Isuzu Motors.
* South Africa on Wednesday formally closed the $1.26 billion sale of 30 percent of state utility Telkom to U.S.'s SBC Communications and Telekom Malaysia.
